verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents a no-code contract builder, reusable templates and workflows, and built-in e-signature. A 2015-era community thread also mentions pre-loaded 'industry standard' templates for startups. So generating and signing a templated financing instrument is plausible, but nothing in the evidence names SAFEs or convertible notes, and the templates appear to need setup in Workflow Designer rather than coming pre-built on standard terms. Missing for 10: evidence of SAFE or convertible-note templates, evidence of standard financing terms out of the box, a founder-oriented fundraising flow, and hands-on corroboration.
